taxonomic_note: Accepted by current Kew treatment. Texas is native at state scale, but only Travis is currently locked inside the project target zone.
look_here_first: Do not stop at the white petals. Confirm with glaucous foliage plus bud, sepal-horn, and mature capsule armature because Argemone albiflora subsp. texana can look very similar in flower.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Travis is locked by the UT Plant Resources Center specimen index. Other strong reviewed records were outside the project target-zone list.

approval_exception.reason: Learner admission is independent from native-range certification.

morphology_keys.comparison_training: A. polyanthemos overlaps strongly with A. albiflora subsp. texana in white flower color and yellow latex; use leaf, bud, sepal-horn, and capsule characters rather than flower color alone.

comparisons.key_distinctions: White petals are not enough. Confirm with mature fruit and bud/sepal characters; A. aurantiaca has orange to reddish-orange latex and very long capsule prickles.

diagnostic_image_needs: direct A. albiflora subsp. texana comparison
